snippet.title: Theme of Re:Zero "The forbidden book and the mysterious spirit" game ("Crossroads" Konomi Suzuki)
snippet.description:
This is the opening song of the new game of Re:Zero, the game it´s called  "The forbidden book and the mysterious spirit" an the song is "Crossroads" by Konomi Suzuki
To view the trailer of the game click here: https://youtu.be/RV-4zyydv9U
Subscribe to my channel if u like it to upload more content ;)
